text:
There were four parts:

DSA: A LeetCode-medium problem based on BFS.

Prompt Engineering: We had to write a set of prompts for a given situation, which were then tested against hidden test cases.

AI-Assisted Debugging: We were given a backend repository containing a bug and had to debug it with the help of AI.

AI-Assisted Feature Development: We had to add a new feature to an existing repository, again with the help of  AI
Can anyone share what questions were asked in the Optum technical round of OA ? what was the pattern of the OA ?

OA was an AI assisted coding round. A codebase was given. You could select either js or python language and then using the AI chatbot, you need to implement a few features within an hour. The AI assistant was very helpful as it provided almost all of the answers. Next was the HR interview, basic HR questions, lasted for around 10-15 mins. Then the final technical round. It varied depending on the interviewer. For some, they asked in depth about the  entire resume, while for some, they asked all which is not present in the resume. So be prepared for everything. They won't ask very hard DSA. Basic or medium might be asked. They focus more on projects, CS fundamentals and your critical thinking and  your knowledge about AI. Also some system design implementations were also asked.
